kind: source ownership investigation; not implementation or runtime acceptance

findings.evidence: guest_memory_lease.c owns eight bounded bounce slots, epoch checks, SRW copy/retirement serialization; no session access in its function bodies. Header imports D access.h although it needs B guest_memory_types.h.
findings.disposition: Move actual lease implementation and definitions to B; preserve existing object composition and provider retirement, symbols, slot ownership, epochs and failures.
findings.not_yet_proved: This alone does not eliminate the F SAS provider or guest-location forwarding.

findings.evidence: compat/guest_location.c forwards three operations to mvdm_guest_location.c; that provider obtains session_thread_current and uses session_guest_memory_acquire/release.
findings.disposition: Move numeric location and lease operations together after replacing private-session selection with the existing B context. Remove superseded forwarding rather than add a second table.
findings.prerequisite: Preserve ACTIVE admission checks and termination behavior without moving session lifecycle or creating duplicate state.

findings.evidence: mvdm_softpc_guest_memory.c performs page preflight through xtrn2phy and c_getPG/CPL/VM, then c_sas_loads/stores; copy_forward uses c_sas_move_bytes_forward.
findings.disposition: Do not move this provider unchanged to B. Identify original C ownership of address translation and memory semantics before eliminating outward dependency.
findings.prerequisite: No new B-to-C exception and no replacement SAS forwarding table presented as completed migration.

findings.evidence: xmsblock.c xmsMoveBlock calls mvdm_xms_cancel_current_operation on parameter-read or forward-copy failure. Its implementation requests session cancellation, not memory allocation or cleanup.
findings.disposition: Product cancellation remains product-owned. Resolve C caller error propagation separately; no blind move into B.
findings.not_yet_proved: Original error delivery equivalence and minimal mirror delta have not yet been established.

findings.evidence: page_domain_create constructs guest page tables/GDT and clock mapping using C exports; enter/leave/reenter changes CR0/CR3/GDT. Same file owns projected USER objects, borrows, retirement lists and Win32 clock resources.
findings.disposition: Mixed ownership, not a generic movable whole file. Separate original CPU boundary from compatibility storage/view mechanics with one lifecycle.
findings.prerequisite: Audit allocation and retained backing closure before extraction; do not move C layouts/CPU algorithms into B or hide them behind callbacks.

findings.evidence: mvdm_command_guest_state.c saves both session epoch and lease epoch, then invokes guest_memory_lease_copy; lease copy serializes against provider retirement.
findings.disposition: Keep task registration/session epoch authority F; preserve B lease epoch and retirement synchronization. Do not conflate the two generations.

verification: Source reads and caller searches only. No source modifications, build, publication or test performed for S14.
next: Complete lease/location/provider ownership design and implement first complete eligible chain; audit WOW separately without counting mere header movement.
